items.text: Rain is ongoing across the area from a large low pressure system.
Wind and rain will move in overnight as a strong coastal storm approaches. Travel could become difficult.
⚠️ The threat for coastal flooding continues through Friday due to increasing astronomical tides.
🌧️ Widespread rain moves into the area tonight, heavy at times in the morning before easing.
Strong northeast winds are expected Thursday and Thursday night, and a Gale Warning is in effect.
COASTAL HAZARDS: An incoming storm will raise flood risk along the tidal shoreline Thursday.
Thursday is looking wet and windy as a strong low pressure system moves north. Widespread rain expected.
